ridSelection.x64Graph: linux-musl-x64 imports linux-musl; linux-musl imports linux
ridSelection.arm64Graph: linux-musl-arm64 is not promoted until a native AArch64 graph and producer are verified
ridSelection.exactAssetPriority: exact musl RID assets are preferred before linux-musl and linux fallback assets
ridSelection.glibcFallback: glibc runtime assets are rejected as musl candidates
ridSelection.packageReferencePolicy: package IDs are explicit; managed package does not auto-select a musl runtime package

dependencyPolicy.libc: musl-only; no glibc loader or glibc-only symbol may enter a candidate payload
dependencyPolicy.backendPolicy: FFmpeg/GStreamer/GTK/Qt/X11/Wayland/font/camera backends require per-target available, unavailable, or disabled evidence
dependencyPolicy.guiPolicy: GUI and display-server dependencies are never implicit generic musl dependencies

requiredEvidence: native x64 producer and independent consumer with digest-pinned Alpine userspace
native AArch64 producer and consumer or an explicit research-only stop decision
Full and Mini profile parity with distinct ABI manifests
musl interpreter, symbol, dependency, and producer-to-package hash closure
codec, DNN, and explicit VideoIO backend smoke with timeout and cleanup
RID exact-asset precedence and glibc-candidate rejection tests
promotionGates: Do not create a generic musl package identity during feasibility
QEMU-only ARM64 evidence cannot promote a package
At least two independently consumed musl userspaces are required
Every architecture-specific identity needs native producer and consumer evidence
Release SBOM, rollback, support contract, and deterministic package hashes must be updated together
stopConditions: Musl-specific toolchain or OpenCV source provenance is not reproducible
Required backend depends on an unbounded external system package
ELF closure contains glibc loader/symbol, producer path, or undeclared GUI/backend SONAME

rollback.onFailure: retain alpine.3.20-x64 compatibility-only and existing glibc distro package identities
